## Etymology, argument and return

The lexical route begins in the mature [Symbol / Account / Trust whole-field](../../submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD.md). Its operation, **Trust keeps the return route active**, distinguishes reliance on an account from possession of the source that gives the account standing. The aphorism condenses that consequence at the limit of determination. This is **evidence register 3, operational homology / authorial construction**. It does not derive either *limit* or *faith* from a common root.

The [Fides / Topos / Logos / Nomos / Natio / Credere whole-field](../../submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/etymologies/trust-place-logos-nomos-natio-credere/WHOLE-FIELD.md) contributes its **Fides/Credere — entrusting under non-possession** branch. [A23](../../submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit.md) develops the temporal consequence: an account can be investigated and acted upon without displacing the lived relation which certification cannot itself manufacture. Historical Latin senses retain registers 1–2 only where their HISTORY/source evidence warrants them; the aphorism's philosophical relation remains register 3.
